ओरी के इस मजेदार अंदाज को देखकर आप भी अपनी हंसी नहीं रोक पाएंगे! 🎬

गुरुवार को इंस्टाग्राम पर शेयर किए गए एक वीडियो में ओरी, Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham फिल्म के करीना कपूर के मशहूर पू वाले लुक में नजर आए।
ओरी ने बेज टैन मिनी स्कर्ट, पिंक शिमरी क्रॉप टॉप और फॉक्स फर स्टोल पहना था।
वीडियो में आलिया भट्ट कैमरा पकड़े हुए थीं और ओरी को देखते ही जोर-जोर से हंसने लगीं।
ओरी ने कहा कि आलिया ने ही उन्हें करीना की तरह कपड़े पहनने को कहा था, जिस पर आलिया ने सफाई दी कि उन्होंने Winnie the Pooh की तरह ड्रेस पहनने को कहा था, पू की तरह नहीं।
इस वीडियो पर खुद ओरिजिनल पू यानी करीना कपूर ने कमेंट कर लिखा, Too Good ❤️。
ओरी ने कैप्शन में लिखा, Bebo Mein Bebo #Halloween2026。

ctx.title: Alia Bhatt laughs as Orry recreates Poo's iconic outfit from Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham; Kareena Kapoor reacts
ctx.summary: Orry recreated Poo’s memorable Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham outfit for Halloween party leaving Alia Bhatt in stitches.
ctx.text:
Bollywood actor Kareena Kapoor 's outfits in Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham remain iconic even more than two decades after the film's release, with fans continuing to recreate Poo's memorable looks. From her colourful crop tops to her glamorous party outfits, Poo's wardrobe became a fashion statement. Recently, social media personality Orry recreated one of her iconic looks, leaving Alia Bhatt in splits. However, it was the OG Poo, Kareena herself, who stole the show with her epic reaction to Orry's hilarious attempt.
On Thursday, Orry took to Instagram and shared a video featuring Alia Bhatt. In the video, Alia could be seen holding the camera as Orry arrives from behind wearing a beige tan mini skirt, a pink shimmery crop top and a faux fur stole along with it. The outfit is exactly what Kareena's Poo had worn in Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham. Orry then asks Alia, "How am I looking?" Just at first glance, Alia broke into laughter.
Orry then pointed out, "Alia, it's not funny; you asked me to dress like Kareena." Alia then clarified, "I asked you to dress like Winnie the Pooh and not Poo." An upset Orry then left the room. Sharing the video, he wrote, "Bebo Mein Bebo #Halloween2026." The video caught attention of Kareena as well, who commented, "Too Good (red heart emoji)."
Orhan Awatramani, popularly known as Orry, has successfully turned his social media popularity and Bollywood connections into a career as an influencer and internet personality. One of his biggest recent television appearances was on the stunt-based reality show Khatron Ke Khiladi 15, hosted by Rohit Shetty, where he surprised viewers by taking on physically challenging stunts and showing a different side of his personality. He made it to the grand finale, finishing as the second runner-up, behind winner Avinash Mishra and first runner-up Rithvik Dhanjani.
Alia is currently awaiting the release of her upcoming movie, Love & War. Helmed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali, the film also stars Ranbir Kapoor and Vicky Kaushal in lead roles. The film is scheduled to release in theatres on January 21, 2027. Kareena recently starred in Meghna Gulzar’s Daayra this year. Prithviraj Sukumaran was her co-star in the film. She has yet to announce her upcoming projects, though reports state she will make a special appearance in Sidharth Anand’s King, starring Shah Rukh Khan and Suhana Khan.
